step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows healthcare data integration from NHS N3/HSCN network and on-premises care settings (Primary/Social Care). Access via N3/HSCN goes through AWS Direct Connect (DX) to an Integration Service running on EC2, backed by an RDS database. The Integration Service calls a FHIR Service on EC2 with its own RDS database. Unstructured content (discharge letters/summaries) from Primary/Social Care flows via Storage Gateway to an S3 bucket. S3 triggers SQS, which triggers Lambda to initiate processing. Lambda invokes the Document Service (EC2), which stores metadata in an RDS instance and content back in S3.

graph.name: Kainos Healthcare Data Interoperability Platform
graph.notes: Microservices platform aggregating healthcare structured data (FHIR standard) and unstructured documents across NHS network.
